title: Against the Big Guns
front_description: The great battle on Geonosis rages on. "Aim right above the fuel cells," shouts Anakin from his gunship, as laser fire blasts the base of the Techno Union ship. Rocked with devastating explosions, the giant fortress begins to tilt over and the attacking Republic gunships split up, flying right past. "Good call, my young Padawan," Obi-Wan remarks in admiration.
back_description: A lavish production painting by Ryan Church depicts the film's climatic battle.
